* Ash captures his first five Pokémon.

* [[Sabrina]] in [[ET04]] (loss)

==Monthly releases==
[[File:Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1.png|thumb|right|Issue #1]]
Preceding the release of Volume 1 in North America were [[List of Electric Tale of Pikachu monthly issues|four monthly releases]] containing one chapter each, comprising the entire first volume collectively. These monthly comic book issues were released by [[VIZ Media]] from November 27, 1998 to February 20, 1999, followed by the Volume 1 release in August. As a bonus, these monthly releases each contained fan letters and fan artwork which were not included in the regular volume releases. 

Despite the original Japanese volume order, in the monthly releases ''Clefairy Tale'' was published as chapter two and ''Play Misty For Me'' was published as chapter three. This creates a continuity error, as {{Ash}} uses his {{AP|Butterfree}} in ''Clefairy Tale'', which supposedly hasn't evolved yet as it evolves in ''Play Misty For Me''. The reason for this is because of controversy from the first issue/chapter being released relatively uncut. Because of this, the second chapter was pushed back to the third issue so that more editing could be done. The chapters were restored to their original order for the collected volume release.

The following monthly comic book issues were released:
* [[Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 1|Issue 1]]
* [[Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 2|Issue 2]]
* [[Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 3|Issue 3]]
* [[Electric Tale of Pikachu issue 4|Issue 4]]

===Other special releases===
A [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu Special Signature Edition Red Version|Special Signature Edition]] was released with the [[Pokémon Video Suitcase]] promotional set. It contains the first two chapters ([[ET01]] and [[ET02]]).
